title: Questioning an Unexpected Bill
context: Nina 发现家庭网络服务本月账单上有一笔不认识的安装费，致电客服 Owen。Owen 登记核查，并预计周五前在账单页面更新结果。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: I am calling about a charge on my internet bill that I do not recognize.
dialogue.zh: 我打电话是想询问网络账单上一笔我不认识的费用。

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: I can help with that. Which charge are you asking about?
dialogue.zh: 我可以帮你。你问的是哪一笔费用？

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: There is a twenty-dollar installation charge on this month's bill.
dialogue.zh: 本月账单上有一笔二十美元的安装费。

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: I see the charge. The bill describes it as an installation fee.
dialogue.zh: 我看到了这笔费用。账单上将它列为安装费。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: I did not request an installation this month. Could you check the record?
dialogue.zh: 我这个月没有申请安装。你能核查一下记录吗？

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: Yes. I will ask our billing team to review the service record.
dialogue.zh: 可以。我会请账务团队核查服务记录。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Does that mean the charge is already removed?
dialogue.zh: 这是不是意味着费用已经取消了？

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: Not yet. The team needs to review it before making a decision.
dialogue.zh: 还没有。团队需要先核查，然后才能作决定。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: When should I expect an update, and where will I find it?
dialogue.zh: 我什么时候可以收到更新，在哪里能看到？

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: We expect an update by Friday on your bill page. Your reference is B-42.
dialogue.zh: 我们预计周五前在你的账单页面更新。你的查询编号是 B-42。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: B-42, and I should check the bill page on Friday for the expected update. Is that right?
dialogue.zh: B-42，我应该周五查看账单页面，看看预计的更新是否出来了，对吗？

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.en: That is right. We expect an update by then. Thank you for bringing the charge to our attention.
dialogue.zh: 对。我们预计届时会有更新。谢谢你告知我们这笔费用。

expressions.en: a charge I do not recognize
expressions.zh: 一笔我不认识的费用，用于指出账单疑问。
expressions.example: There is a charge I do not recognize.

expressions.zh: 安装费，指账单上列出的安装服务费用。
expressions.example: The bill lists an installation fee.

expressions.zh: 核查记录，请对方查看相关信息。
expressions.example: Could you check the service record?

expressions.zh: 核查这笔费用，不表示已经做出处理决定。
expressions.example: The billing team will review the charge.

expressions.zh: 查询编号，可用于后续跟进。
expressions.example: I wrote down the reference number.

pronunciation: installation 的重音在第三音节 /ˌɪnstəˈleɪʃən/；charge 以 /dʒ/ 结尾，不要多加元音。reference 的重音在第一音节 /ˈrefərəns/。

practice.title: Part 1 · Checking bills
practice.prompt: Do you usually check bills before paying them?
practice.answer: Yes. I look at the total and any charges I do not recognize. If something is unclear, I ask the provider to explain it.

practice.title: Part 2 · A billing question
practice.prompt: Describe an imagined time you questioned a bill. Say what surprised you, whom you contacted, and how you followed up.
practice.answer: Imagine that I notice a service charge on my internet bill that I do not understand. I call the provider and explain which charge I am asking about. The agent reads the description, but I still need more information, so I ask for a review of the service record. I write down the reference number and the expected update date. Then I check the bill page for the result. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Billing information
practice.prompt: Why should service providers explain charges clearly?
practice.answer: Clear descriptions help customers understand what they are paying for. They also make it easier to identify a possible mistake and ask for a review.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 先听完整对话，再逐句跟读，再完成口头练习。
practice.answer: 用四到六句指出费用、请求解释和核查，复述查询编号及预计更新的时间和位置。
